parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located on the toaster's front panel, typically used to activate or cancel the toasting process.
parts.Functional_description: This button is pressed to start or stop the toasting cycle, providing user control over operation.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: Another plastic button on the toaster, likely used for a secondary function such as defrost or reheat.
parts.Functional_description: This button provides additional control options, such as reheating or defrosting bread.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward when pressed and returns outward after release.

parts.name: Slider
parts.Basic_description: A plastic slider located on the toaster's front, used to lower bread slices into the heating slots.
parts.Functional_description: The slider engages the internal mechanism to start the toasting process and hold the bread in place.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward to engage and upward to release the bread after toasting.

parts.name: Slider
parts.Basic_description: A secondary slider, possibly for adjusting browning level or controlling a second toasting slot.
parts.Functional_description: It adjusts the toasting intensity or controls a separate heating element.
parts.Movement_description: It moves horizontally or vertically depending on the design to adjust settings.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the toaster made of stainless steel, housing all internal components and providing structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It encloses the heating elements, wiring, and mechanical parts, ensuring safety and durability.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a stable base for the entire appliance.
